key_findings: **Client-architecture 'The LuaControl hierarchy is the runtime surface' PROMOTED**: 'Bahamut's actor/status state framework derives from a 3+-tier Lua control class hierarchy'. Evidence: 12 BCS-Y entries spanning all 3 tiers; RTTI confirmation that StatusBase inherits LuaControl via ActorBase; ChangeActorSubStatStatusReceiver lives in Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command::System namespace.

**LuaControl has 4 derived classes**: LuaManyTentativeControlCreator (engine-side), ActorBase (script-side, 23 derived classes), NilControl (Null Object), CommandEventRelationControlBase (script-side).
**ActorBase is the widely-used Tier-1 intermediate**: 23 callers of ActorBase::ctor = 23 derived classes (script-side actor specializations). StatusBase is one of them.

**ChangeActorSubStatStatusReceiver namespace identified**: Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command::System. Confirms the Lua-bridge architecture extends to packet Receivers, not just script-side actor classes.

**Status-id namespace offsets**: ChangeActorSubStatStatusReceiver uses +200000 for status_value < 0x8000, +217232 (200000+17232) for status_value >= 0x8000. The 200000 base + 17232 high-half offset = namespace key for sub-status types.

**FUN_00CC70E0 is a generic status-id-to-intern-string formatter**, not Lua-bridge-specific. Used by 8 functions (this entry plus BCS-Y-1368). The 3-level thunk chain (FUN_00CC70E0 -> FUN_00CD8050 -> FUN_00D03A50) implements a hash-table-based string-intern key generator over a global epoch counter.

**FUN_00D03A50 hash mechanism**: takes (raw_status_id, epoch_counter=DAT_0130D426) -> generates ((epoch+0xa00) * 0x100000) high-bits-shifted hash + looks up in a global intern table. Adds new entries on miss.
**NilControl is a Null Object pattern**: _anon_DAD46F4B::NilControl is a TU-internal singleton for LuaControl, returned when real-instance lookup fails. Avoids NULL-check at every callsite.
